reviews.comment: I took Professor Kagalwala's summer 209 course. It was pretty easy, as he guided the class through writing the final paper, which comprised most of the final grade. All assignments were portions of the paper that we combined at the end to create the final paper.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Kagalwala was one of the best professors that I ever had. If you participate in his class, he will remember your name. He cares about you learning and will drop his lesson plans if he feels like the class is not grasping his lesson. I highly encourage participating in class, and speaking up when you don't understand what is going on.

Ali was fine in the beginning of the semester but as the class got harder, he also got less patient with us. He made the class seem way more complicated than it actually is and is not good at explaining things. Your TA matters cause they're the ones grading your papers and teaching your coding sessions.

Dr. K is cool and made 209 as easy as he could even though its a difficult subject. Ur TA matters a lot; most of them are good, but my classmates and I were always confused and hesitant to ask questions because we were always met with a rude response. A few online quizzes, a few hw assignments, and 4 papers. Pray you get a good TA and you're set.

I loved this class! He was insightful and VERY clear on what he wanted in the essays. The class is based on one ongoing paper that is supplemented with R. So hypothetically, when you get to the last paper it should be an easy A since you've worked on it all semester. Only thing is the class is heavily dependent on TA grading. Few HW/Quiz grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is a difficult class, but he definitely made it as easy as he could. There is no exams, but there are four major essays that require you to code on R. Your TA will make or break your grade because they grade everything. You HAVE to go into office hours and have him check your code before submitting essays because chances are it's wrong.

Kagalwala is a great prof who listens to students and takes feedback into account! His lectures were super interesting and he didn't assign busy work, but made sure that we understood and could discuss critical topics of importance. Topics were interesting and the class wasn't difficult. He has been one of my favorite profs and I highly recommend!

He is so so so boring. He's also very rude and has a lot of attitude. His lectures are extremely boring- and for grades he just makes you take quizzes. But in terms of comparative politics, you won't learn much in this class, and if you need any help, his demeanor makes it intimidating to even attend office hours.
Professor Kagalwala was a simple class would take again if you see him get him.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As the semester went by the class and lectures got really interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Kagalwala was very clear on what we needed to know for the exams and there were no extra assignments or anything required for the course. It was purely just reading the textbook and coming to class and discussing the information, which was always very interesting and he made the class enjoyable through his lectures.

Kagalwala was a great professor and he only got better as the semester went on. 90% of the grade was based on three exams in which you would have over and hour to answer 20-30 multiple choice questions. The exams were open note/open resource and you were allowed to look things up and consult the textbook. Overall an interesting class
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: People didn't like him at the beginning because the class bombed one quiz, which was only worth about 5% of the grade anyway. Still, he listened and changed his teaching style, and it really helped students learn. He's a great professor and an all-around cool guy, and I really enjoyed taking his class this semester.

As stated by others, Prof K was not the best at the beginning of the semester and it was obvious that he was new. However, he responded to feedback from the class very well (which I respect him a lot for) and the tests and quizzes became easier. 3 tests and 2 quizzes which are open-note. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT which can add 5 points to ur total grade.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor K. Started out semester somewhat decent but as the class went on he got more into the rhythm of the he did really well for the remainder of the semester. As other people have said he took feedback well and was always very straight forward with the lectures and assignments. I would definitely take another class taught by him.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Out of my 4 years in college there are only a handful of professors who made me want to go to class and Prof. K is one of them. If you want to take a class where the material is interesting, the professor cares about the students understanding the material, and you are not drowning in course work - this is the class to take.

His teaching at first wasn't the best, but as the semester went on he improved immensely. I believe this was his first semester teaching, so it was atrial and error. However, he took feedback well and ended this semester being an extremely helpful professor. The course material was interesting and I would take this class again.

At first, the class started out rough but because he's new. However, he was open to feedback and class got better and the quizzes/exams got easier to study for. Quizzes and tests are open-note and he reviews content a class day before tests. Overall, this class is doable.

This class started rough, but it's because he's new. Class got better over the semester & lectures are entertaining. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, he will sometimes ask questions that will end up on exams/quizzes. Everything is open note and easy, but there aren't many assignments so be careful of that. Otherwise, take Kagalwala!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I understand why his ratings are low, I didn't like his teaching style in the beginning and it was obvious that he was new. However, as the semester went on he got better at explaining the slides and giving the class time to write down the info. I enjoyed going to his class, easy A and interesting/funny teacher
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course setup makes it doable to get a good grade. Although there aren't many grades, they're all open note with ample time. The first quiz was hard, but that is only worth 5% of the grade, and after that it gets easier. However, I think if you study the slides and pay a bit of attention in class it is pretty easy to get an A in the course.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are only a few grades in this class but he still makes it easy to be successful! Extra credit is offered, he receives feedback well, and everything is open note. The notes are available even if you don't attend but some material is based on lectures so I wouldn't recommend never going. And he is pretty funny so the lectures aren't too bad.
Ali is truly a model student and teacher. He always took the time to explain items outside office hours and was really patient
Just don't take this course with this professor

Professor has very confusing lectures and refuses to use a microphone in a large lecture hall despite students asking him to speak up countless times. With only 5 extremely difficult grades that he warns are highly based on what he says in lectures, it is very hard to be successful in his class. Do yourself a favor by not taking this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very few grades, long and mundane lectures. and an off-putting personality on top of it all. Avoid this guy like the plague.

Very confusing. Only 5 grades. Two quizzes and three tests. His lectures are very long, boring, and he goes extremely fast to the point where you can't get everything off of the slides. His tests consist of stuff he says in class, readings from the textbook, and whatever is on the slides in his lectures (which don't help). I don't recommend.
